Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Strengthening Tax Cooperation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (as amended in 2020); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Market Entities, PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024; in Taiwan, the Money Laundering Control Act (Republic of China) and the beneficial-owner declaration obligations under the Taiwan Company Act

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 23-25, 41, 43-47 and 52; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 4, 6, 12 and 31; Regulations for the Implementation of the Foreign Investment Law (2020), Articles 2-7; Administrative Regulations on Company Registration; cross-strait Taiwan investor treatment applied by reference to foreign investment rules under the PRC Foreign Investment Law framework.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration (MSA) registration department, operating under the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR); foreign investment information reporting to the same one-stop business-startup platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Establishment Registration Application for a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company (Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Filing).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no blocked escrow account is required for an ISIC 6201 WFOE. The shareholders may set registered capital in the Articles of Association at any lawful amount, including RMB 10,000, and all subscribed capital must be fully paid within five years of establishment pursuant to Article 47 of the 2023 Company Law. Capital may be contributed in cash or lawful in-kind consideration and, if the investor is foreign or Taiwan-based, must be remitted through the WFOE foreign exchange capital account after foreign exchange registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: WHEREAS the sole shareholder of the Company has resolved to establish the Company as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise under the laws of the People's Republic of China, with registered capital to be subscribed and paid in accordance with the Articles of Association, and the directors have been authorized to take all incorporation and governance actions necessary to commence lawful business; and WHEREAS the Company is engaged in ISIC 6201 public commercial web-scraping and proxy API gateway services, and the shareholder has convened this first board of directors to approve the organizational and operational foundation of the Company; NOW, THEREFORE, the first board of directors hereby resolves as follows: (1) Incorporation and share capital subscription: the board adopts the Articles of Association as submitted, confirms the total registered capital of the Company as stated in the Articles of Association, and authorizes the legal representative to open a capital contribution account, issue capital contribution notices, and record all shareholder contributions in the share register. (2) Registered office: the registered office shall be the location specified in the establishment application, and the legal representative is authorized to execute the office lease and to file the lease and property ownership documents with the local Market Supervision Administration and tax authority. (3) Bank accounts and banking authorization: the Company shall open a basic deposit account, a general deposit account, and such foreign exchange capital accounts as may be necessary with the bank selected by management; the board designates the general manager and the finance officer as authorized signing persons, with all payments exceeding RMB 200,000 or USD 30,000 requiring dual signatures; the selected bank is authorized to rely on a certified copy of this resolution together with the legal representative identification. (4) Statutory officer appointments: the board appoints the initial legal representative, the general manager, and the supervisor as set out in the respective appointment letters; the general manager shall have day-to-day management powers, and the supervisor shall supervise the directors and senior management. (5) Industrial licensing and compliance: the board confirms that the initial business scope requires no physical manufacturing license, environmental impact assessment, or civil defense fire permit; management shall notify the board immediately should actual operations expand into regulated telecommunications, internet content, or data hosting activities. (6) Effectiveness: this resolution shall take effect upon adoption and constitutes a binding corporate act of the Company, and the corporate secretary is directed to place this resolution in the statutory minutes book and to distribute certified copies to the bank, tax authority, and relevant government registries.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Approval and Foreign Investment Negative-List Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration (MSA) enterprise registration online portal, operating under SAMR.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the enterprise registration portal operated by the local Market Supervision Administration. Select the establishment of a foreign-invested limited liability company and complete the foreign investment negative-list questionnaire to verify that public commercial web-scraping and proxy API gateway services under ISIC 6201 and NAICS 518210 are permitted without a statutory license. Submit at least three candidate enterprise names in the format of administrative division, company-specific name, and limited liability company suffix. Designate the legal representative or formation agent in the online system and await issuance of the Name Pre-Approval Notice. If the investor is from Taiwan, indicate the Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan investor type and attach the cross-strait notarized investor certification.
required_dossiers: Name pre-approval application form
Designation of the legal representative or formation agent
Passport, Taiwan identity certificate, or investor business registration certificate
Statement of business scope aligned with ISIC 6201 and NAICS 518210
Power of attorney to the formation agent if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name pre-approval is refused, the designated agent may immediately submit up to three replacement names through the same online portal; each replacement submission restarts a normal three-day review clock. If the application is suspended for incomplete information, the agent shall cure the deficiency within the MSA-specified period, typically five to ten business days, before the name approval lapses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, Translation, and Authentication of Foreign or Taiwan Investor Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public in the investor's home jurisdiction; for Taiwan investors, notarization plus authentication through the applicable cross-strait notarization channel; for other foreign investors, consular legalization or apostille by the competent authority.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a notary public in the investor's home jurisdiction to notarize the investor's certificate of incorporation, articles of incorporation or equivalent constitutive documents, the board resolution or shareholder resolution approving the WFOE investment, and the passport or identity certificate of the authorized signatory. For Taiwan investors, the notarized documents must be forwarded through the lawful cross-strait notarization and verification channel, and a verified copy must be submitted to the provincial notary association before the MSA will accept such documents. For non-Taiwan foreign investors, apply for consular legalization or apostille as appropriate and obtain certified bilingual Chinese-English translations if the MSA requires local-language versions. All notarized documents should be issued within the past six months unless local rules permit older documents.
required_dossiers: Notarized investor certificate of incorporation or business registration
Notarized corporate or shareholder resolution approving the establishment of the WFOE
Notarized passport or Taiwan identity certificate of the authorized signatory
Bilingual translation certified by a qualified translation company
Board or shareholder power of attorney authorizing the formation agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notarized document is rejected as unverified, return the document to the notary for a supplementary page or corrected notarization. If rejection is based on authentication failure, use the appropriate consular, apostille, or cross-strait verification channel to re-authenticate the same underlying document; no new investor corporate resolution is required unless the original resolution has expired or has been materially amended.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Establishment Registration with the Local Market Supervision Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration (MSA) one-stop business start-up window or SAMR online enterprise registration portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed Company Establishment Registration Application Form and all supporting dossiers through the one-stop business start-up window or online MSA system. Confirm that the business scope wording includes computer programming, data processing, software services, and commercial data pipeline services to the extent permitted. Ensure that the registered capital amount and the five-year contribution schedule comply with the 2023 Company Law. The sole shareholder must execute the Articles of Association, and the designated representative must complete the online identity verification before the filing is accepted. The MSA will review the company name, registered address, investor qualifications, governance structure, and the legal representative appointment. No registration fee is charged by the MSA; upon approval, the MSA issues the business license with a unified social credit code, after which tax registration and company seal filing information are automatically generated.
required_dossiers: Company Establishment Registration Application Form signed by the sole shareholder or designated representative
Articles of Association executed by the sole shareholder
Name Pre-Approval Notice issued by the MSA
Notarized and authenticated investor qualification documents
Legal representative appointment resolution and legal representative identification
Supervisor appointment document and supervisor identification
Registered office lease agreement and landlord property ownership certificate
Power of attorney and formation agent identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MSA suspends the application pending correction, the designated representative shall cure the deficiency within the notice period, generally ten business days. If an adverse refusal is issued, administrative reconsideration may be filed with the same-level people's government or the superior MSA within sixty days, to be followed by judicial review through an administrative lawsuit within six months if necessary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Seal Engraving, Bank Account Opening, and Statutory Tax and Foreign Exchange Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving company; licensed commercial bank; State Taxation Administration local office; State Administration of Foreign Exchange through delegated banks.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the business license, take the license and legal representative identification to a public security bureau-approved seal engraving company to produce the company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal, and contract seal, then register the seal impressions with the MSA and tax records. Open the RMB basic deposit account at the selected licensed bank and, if foreign capital will be injected, open a foreign exchange capital account under the direct investment foreign exchange registration procedures delegated to the bank by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. Present the original business license, seal impression certificate, legal representative passport, Articles of Association, and the board resolution authorizing bank signatories. Complete e-tax taxpayer registration, social insurance registration, and statistical reporting code application within thirty days. The bank may require source-of-funds declarations and enhanced due diligence because the target payment rails include Stripe and USDC stablecoin.
required_dossiers: Original business license with unified social credit code
Seal engraving certificate and seal impression card
Legal representative passport or identity certificate
Articles of Association
Board resolution authorizing bank account opening and signing authorities
E-tax and social insurance registration forms generated by the one-stop platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects account opening under AML or CTF enhanced due diligence, provide the standard source-of-funds declaration, the itemized capital contribution schedule, and the board resolution. If tax registration is blocked, visit the local tax service hall to obtain the zero registration confirmation. If foreign exchange registration is deferred, submit the capital payment plan and original investment contract to the designated bank for manual clearance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - ISIC 6201 is a pure digital data-processing and software service category; no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing activity is performed.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no Environmental Impact Assessment report or environmental registration is required for an office-based ISIC 6201 data service company.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater, no VOC emissions, and no hazardous industrial waste generation; workplace IT waste shall be disposed of as ordinary non-hazardous office refuse under local municipal waste rules, with data-bearing media destroyed or recycled by licensed e-waste vendors if required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for non-industrial office operations; general commercial building fire safety certification and landlord-provided fire extinguisher compliance remain applicable, but no Civil Defense fire permit, structural load inspection for manufacturing, or workplace safety approval for industrial installation is required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance (Taiwan), acting through the Taxation Agency and the applicable Regional National Taxation Bureau; the electronic registration and filing portal is the Ministry of Finance Tax E-Portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident entity establishing a Taiwan branch or subsidiary must first obtain business registration approval from the Ministry of Economic Affairs. Within the statutory period after business registration, and before commencing taxable sales if earlier, the entity must file for tax registration with the National Taxation Bureau having jurisdiction over its registered business address. The application must include the approved articles/memorandum and registration certificate, the appointed tax and fiscal representative's identification, and the branch or company applicant data. Upon successful registration, the Bureau issues the statutory Unified Business Number (Tax ID Number), which is then used for all Business Tax, Uniform Invoice, filing, and payment obligations. The foreign entity must maintain a resident tax agent for service of process and tax notices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Taiwan does not offer a check-the-box regime or hybrid mismatch elections; a Taiwan-registered limited company is automatically subject to entity-level profit-seeking enterprise income tax and standard Business Tax.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax Act)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for standard Business Tax registration; any person making taxable sales of goods or services in Taiwan must register before commencement. Small-scale dealers with average monthly turnover below NT$80,000 for goods or NT$40,000 for services may instead be subject to the simplified 1% non-value-added tax collection regime rather than standard VAT filing.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT-registered businesses must issue Uniform Invoices for taxable sales. Qualified businesses must adopt Electronic Uniform Invoices and transmit invoice data to the Ministry of Finance Electronic Invoice Integrated Platform, either directly via the Turnkey interface or through an approved Common Carrier/Value-Added Service Center. Taiwan does not apply real-time continuous fiscal clearance or digital stamping; anti-fraud protection is provided by mandatory serialized Uniform Invoice numbering, electronic data reconciliation, consumer encryption codes, and the platform's validation controls.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under Article 7 of the Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax Act to goods physically exported from Taiwan and to services sold to foreign customers where the service is not consumed in Taiwan and consideration is received in foreign currency. For the public commercial web scraping and proxy API business model, the zero-rating claim is available upon proof that the recipient is a non-Taiwan entity, the service is performed or consumed outside Taiwan, and the export proceeds are remitted to and repatriated into Taiwan.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (export customs entry) as approved by the Taiwan Customs Administration
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export of goods
Foreign Exchange Proceeds Receipt Certificate / Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) issued by an authorized domestic bank
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Taxation Bureau may conduct documentary and transactional audits of zero-rated exports. If the export customs declaration, transport documentation, or foreign exchange inward remittance certificate is missing, untrue, or insufficient, the Business Tax previously zero-rated is clawed back at 5% with a surcharge. Under the Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax Act, an underpayment caused by false records is subject to a penalty of up to 3 times the tax underpaid. Forging customs declarations or remittance documentation may also trigger criminal liability under the Tax Collection Act and applicable customs-related criminal statutes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC); foreign exchange administration is delegated to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) with provincial branches executing registration, monitoring, and enforcement for the WFOE.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is convertible for current-account items, including cross-border service-trade receipts from the commercial scraping-API business and the remittance of dividends derived from genuinely realized after-tax profits, subject to genuine-verification documentation. Capital-account items remain qualified and require prior SAFE registration: inbound equity capital injection, cross-border loans (foreign debt), and outbound guarantees all require registration or filing. Profit remittance hurdles are moderate: remittance of dividends requires (i) audited statutory financial statements, (ii) WFOE board profit-distribution resolution, (iii) the SAFE Foreign Exchange Business Registration Certificate or its online record, (iv) corporate income tax completion proof or tax-payment certificates, and (v) a mandatory tax/filing record (Service Trade and Other Items Foreign Exchange Payment Tax Filing Record) where the remittance equals or exceeds the USD 50,000 equivalent threshold. Because the WFOE's commercial model is service and data-pipeline exports, there is no customs declaration gate, but banks and SAFE will apply enhanced genuine-trade verification to the underlying API usage and revenue trail.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The mandatory export-proceeds surrender system was abolished in 2012. The WFOE may retain 100% of export receipts in a domestic foreign-currency operational account; no statutory conversion ratio exists. Nevertheless, repatriation of service-export proceeds to onshore bank accounts is mandatory and must be collected within the trade-monitoring verification period (typically 180 days for goods; service receipts are assessed on a contract-by-contract basis). Proceeds may be converted to RMB at the bank at the WFOE's discretion provided the receipt is traceable to a genuine service-trade transaction evidenced by contract, invoice, and delivery/usage logs of the scraping-API and proxy services.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI Capital Fund FCY Account) and Operational Account (FCY/RMB Current Account)
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account, with API-enabled corporate banking and cross-border fintech settlement capabilities

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as a primary local treasury rail. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Airwallex, Currenxie, Payoneer) cannot act as licensed domestic clearing banks in China, cannot hold statutory capital, and cannot satisfy SAFE capital-account registration or tax-refund linkage. They may serve only as an auxiliary collection point for overseas revenue received via Stripe or USDC conversions, but routing material service-trade receipts through unregulated EMIs will trigger enhanced AML scrutiny due to reduced traceability to SAFE's trade monitoring. All statutory capital, dividend remittances, and tax settlements must flow through a licensed tier-1 Chinese bank account in the WFOE's own name.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory. The legal representative and the ultimate beneficial owner are required to attend an in-person KYC interview at the Chinese bank branch where the WFOE's account is opened. Remote opening is not available for a non-resident-controlled WFOE engaged in a Medium-Risk-Enhanced web-scraping data-pipeline business. A notarized and consular-legalized power of attorney can authorize a senior local manager to co-sign, but at least one physical appearance by the controlling principal or an officer with signatory authority is required at account activation. Some banks additionally require a second interview at the local branch when the capital account is funded and when the tax filing record is issued for outbound remittances.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owner domiciled in Taiwan with no onshore economic presence except the WFOE
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized certificate of incorporation and business license of the WFOE; certified copy of the shareholder register and group structure chart; passport copies of the UBO and directors; proof of residential address; source-of-funds statements supported by six months of bank statements; signed beneficial-ownership declaration; and an organizational-chart affidavit explaining the Taiwan parent and Chinese operating entity relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity API-scraping revenue with low invoice granularity, automated payment volumes, and cross-border clients in data-intensive industries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client onboarding KYC files for each material counterparty; executed master service agreements and order forms; billing and invoice logs generated from the API gateway; monthly settlement reports from Stripe and any licensed OTC conversion venue; system logs demonstrating API usage, bandwidth metering, and payment triggers; and a written explanation of the unit-economics of proxy bandwidth resale.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cryptocurrency (USDC) treasury flows embedded in the target payment rails
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A board-approved written treasury policy strictly limiting crypto to instant fiat settlement through a licensed and compliant conversion channel; complete wallet-to-bank transaction hash trail; no crypto-to-crypto internal transfers; periodic independent auditor attestation of source of funds; and evidence that all USDC receipts are attributable to the commercial scraping-API service invoices and not to third-party or personal transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border service-trade receipts without customs documentation, typical of ISIC 6201 digital services
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Service-trade contracts, delivery records, API access logs, invoicing schedules, and SAFE/BOP reporting forms; the Service Trade and Other Items Foreign Exchange Payment Tax Filing Record where applicable; corporate income tax and VAT filings reconciling declared revenue to bank inflows; and a quarterly internal reconciliation pack mapping each remittance to a unique invoice reference.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Reputation and sanctions risk from proxy endpoints, scraping targets, and the possibility of access to restricted markets or persons
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions-screening policy against UN, US OFAC, EU, and Chinese restricted-party lists for all clients; geo-IP filtering and domain-blocklist enforcement evidence; Data Security Law and Personal Information Protection Law compliance certificates or third-party data-protection audit reports; contractual clauses prohibiting collection of personal data without lawful basis; and a whistleblower/compliance incident register demonstrating remediation capability.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan shareholder injects equity capital in USD (TWD is not a broadly tradable onshore settlement currency) via SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's SAFE-registered Capital Fund Foreign Currency Account, using the balance-of-payments purpose code for direct-investment capital contribution (direct-investment category, e.g., BOP code 621011). Prior posting, the WFOE must complete (i) market-entry filing with the Ministry of Commerce or its delegated authority, (ii) SAFE FDI registration and receipt of the Foreign Exchange Business Registration Certificate, and (iii) bank-side verification of the filing code against the remitter and remittance narrative. Once credited, capital funds may be settled into RMB only for self-use operating purposes: payroll, rent, taxes, procurement of bandwidth and data-center services, and general administrative expenses. Prohibited deployments include equity investment in third parties, loans to related parties beyond permitted centralized-dealing arrangements, wealth-management products, and non-self-use real property. For qualifying WFOEs under the capital-account income payment facilitation pilot, the bank may allow self-verification payment with the WFOE retaining transactional evidence, but all documentation must be produced to SAFE within the statutory retention window.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operating disbursements to Taiwan vendors for software licenses, data-center bandwidth, and proxy infrastructure will clear via SWIFT MT103 against a service contract, commercial invoice, and the WFOE's bank payment instruction. A Commercial Letter of Credit is not appropriate for data and API services and should be reserved only for incidental goods procured under Incoterms-backed purchase orders. Service payments above the USD 50,000 equivalent require the Service Trade and Other Items Foreign Exchange Payment Tax Filing Record; payments to Taiwan residents are also subject to PRC withholding tax on service fees (VAT on cross-border taxable services plus WHT on the non-resident's income) unless a reduced rate applies under the cross-strait double-taxation arrangement or an applicable treaty. Outbound dividend remittances to the Taiwan shareholder clear by MT103 supported by (i) the board profit-distribution resolution, (ii) PRC audited annual financial statements, (iii) completed corporate income tax settlement and dividend withholding at 10% or the arrangement-reduced rate, and (iv) the tax filing record. All outbound wires must match invoice currency, amounts, and beneficiary names exactly to avoid SAFE penalty classification.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore RMB FX forwards (forward settlement and sale) with settlement against real current-account receipts and payments provenance.
Onshore FX swaps (foreign exchange swaps between RMB and USD) for temporary liquidity matching of capital inflows and dividend payment timing.
Cross-currency swaps (RMB/USD) on matched cross-border loan or liability exposures, following SAFE registration and real-demand verification.

Zero-cost collar structures combining bought USD-call/RMB-put and USD-put/RMB-call options with a licensed SAFE-designated bank, limited to hedged exposure not exceeding certified genuine trade flows.
NDFs (non-deliverable forwards) are not permitted onshore for the WFOE; offshore CNH NDFs are restricted as speculative non-real-demand instruments and must not be used in the corporate treasury.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Withholding and Income-Certificate Filing (salaries, directors' fees, dividends to the CN parent, and foreign API vendor payments)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by January 31 for the preceding calendar year; remittance of withheld tax follows each monthly payment date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate filing of withholding slips: fines of NT$7,500–NT$45,000; under-withholding: penalty of 1x–3x the deficient amount plus interest; personal liability of the responsible officer where the company cannot remit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Provisional Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually September 1 – September 30; provisional payment equals one-half of the prior-year tax; waived where no taxable income or the prior-year tax is under NT$2,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 1% for every 2 days of delay, capped at 15%, plus interest on the unpaid provisional tax; shortfall is recaptured at annual settlement with additional penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return and Undistributed Surplus Levy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually May 1 – May 31 following the calendar year-end; undistributed surplus levy assessed on the same return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of 1% of unpaid tax for each 2-day delay, capped at 15%; statutory interest accrues after 30 days; understatement penalties up to 3x evaded tax; persistent non-payment triggers tax liens, asset seizure, and coercive dissolution by MOEA.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: House Tax Filing covering company-occupied or registered premises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local municipality or county tax bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually May 1 – May 31; tax imposed as of the February final day of the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 1% per 2 days, capped at 15%; non-declaration of occupied premises attracts a 2x–3x penalty on evaded tax; unpaid house tax constitutes a statutory lien on the property.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting and acknowledgment of annual financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders of record; resolutions changing directors or articles must be filed with the MOEA Department of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before June 30 of the following year (within six months after fiscal year-end per Company Act Article 170)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of NT$10,000–NT$50,000 on the responsible person; MOEA may convene the meeting at company expense; repeated default supports compulsory dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Operation Report of the Foreign-Invested Enterprise (WFOE chain reporting)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before June 30 following the reporting fiscal year, per the Investment Commission notification cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or false submission: administrative warnings, suspension of fast-track processing of subsequent investment and registration applications, and potential revocation of foreign investment approval under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Responsible Persons and Major Shareholders Information Declaration (annual UBO-cycle filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce – Company Responsible Persons and Major Shareholders Information Declaration Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the MOEA-designated date (typically by the end of June); change-based filing within 15 days of any change in directors, supervisors, managers, or shareholders holding more than 10%
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Company Act Article 22-1: fines of NT$50,000–NT$500,000 per violation; repeated breaches trigger consecutive fines and blocking of other corporate registration services.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Land Value Tax Filing where the WFOE owns real property
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local municipality or county tax bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually November 1 – November 30; tax imposed as of August 31 of the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of 1% per 2 days, capped at 15%; delinquent land tax creates a superior statutory lien ranking ahead of mortgages and may support compulsory execution on land assets.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No automatic independent statutory audit applies to a private limited company under the Taiwan Company Act. A CPA-certified and attested income tax filing is mandatory when prior-year gross revenue plus non-operating income equals or exceeds NT$100,000,000. Mandatory audit also applies to public or listed companies, financial enterprises, and companies whose foreign investment approval, bank lending covenants, or CN-parent group reporting requires audited local-GAAP or T-IFRS statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Private companies apply Taiwan Enterprise Accounting Standards (EAS) as local GAAP under the Commercial Accounting Act; public companies apply Taiwan IFRS (T-IFRS); taxable income is reconciled per the Income Tax Act using the tax-adjusted accounting books.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The WFOE must keep an up-to-date shareholder register and substantial-controller register at its registered office in Taiwan. Every share transfer or capital change during the year must be recorded in the Register of Members immediately; where a director, supervisor, manager, or more-than-10% shareholder changes, the MOEA declaration must be refiled within 15 days. The annual declaration cycle confirms the ultimate beneficial owner as of the MOEA-designated date and reconciles year-end shareholdings against the statutory registers. The CN-parent ownership chain must also be disclosed in the foreign-investment annual operation report. AML screening records for the e-commerce API settlement rails (USDC and Stripe) must be retained as part of beneficial-ownership compliance.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – 1,800 per annum (registered office, local company agent, and corporate secretarial support in Taipei)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – 9,000 per annum for a CPA-attested tax return with EAS-reviewed financial statements; USD 8,000 – 20,000 per annum where a full T-IFRS audit with cross-border group consolidation support is required by the CN parent.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% profit-seeking enterprise income tax (營利事業所得稅)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday for public commercial web scraping or proxy API gateway services. Available benefits include qualified R&D investment tax credits under the Statute for Industrial Innovation, a 5% retained earnings surtax exemption when profits are distributed in the following year, and scope-limited incentives only for specific Government-approved strategic emerging industries.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: 營利事業所得稅結算申報書 (Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return); e-filed through the Ministry of Finance E-Filing and Payment Portal (電子申報繳稅服務) at tax.nat.gov.tw
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final return, plus quarterly provisional estimated tax declarations (provisional payment due by 30 September and, where applicable, an estimated second-half filing by the end of February of the following year)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return due within 5 months after fiscal year-end (calendar-year enterprises: 1 May–31 May of the following year); a one-month extension may be available when a CPA certifies the accounts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross operating revenue: aggregate SaaS/API subscription fees, scraping gateway fees, usage-licensed data revenue, and bandwidth metering fees
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all Taiwan-source revenue on the resident WFOE return; no apportionment to a foreign fixed base is permitted unless a separate Taiwan branch has been registered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold: server bandwidth, proxy infrastructure depreciation, data acquisition costs, and third-party database license fees
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only costs directly attributable to revenue generation; related-party recharges must be supported by contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses: payroll, rent, cloud computing, legal, accounting, and AML/KYC compliance costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border service fees paid to an overseas parent are expensed only when arm's-length and substantiated; otherwise 20% withholding and transfer pricing adjustment apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating income and expenses: foreign exchange gains or losses, crypto-to-fiat conversion gains, interest income, and gains on disposal of digital assets
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cryptocurrency holdings used for payment rails must be valued at fair market value on conversion; unrealized gains are not recognized for Taiwan profit-seeking enterprise income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income: gross revenue minus deductible costs and expenses, adjusted for related-party transaction corrections and re-characterization under Article 12-1
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Carryforward prior 10 years of eligible losses; no group relief or loss consolidation is permitted between the Taiwan WFOE and its overseas affiliates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax payable and retained earnings surtax: 20% computed tax, minus provisional tax payments and withholding tax credits, plus 5% retained earnings surtax on undistributed profits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE is a Taiwan tax resident; subsequent dividends declared to the non-resident Chinese parent will be subject to a separate 20% dividend withholding tax at distribution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual filing incurs a 3% surcharge of the assessed tax for each two-month period of delay, capped at 9%, plus interest on underpaid tax. Non-filing or an estimated assessment may additionally trigger an administrative fine under Income Tax Act Article 110, and criminal liability for fraudulent tax evasion under the Tax Collection Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 20% withholding tax on dividends paid to a non-resident enterprise without a fixed place of business or business agent in Taiwan; 21% for non-resident individuals.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Cross-Strait Agreement on the Avoidance of Double Taxation has been signed but has not entered into force, so dividends paid to a mainland Chinese shareholder remain subject to the statutory 20% rate. For a resident of a treaty jurisdiction, the withholding agent must file an application for reduced withholding before payment, supplying a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the treaty jurisdiction, evidence of beneficial ownership, and a completed DTA relief application form; treaty rates are applied only after prior tax-authority approval.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding is 20% for royalties and interest paid to a non-resident enterprise without a fixed place of business in Taiwan; treaty rate reductions, commonly 10%–15%, may apply upon submission of an approved TRC and beneficial ownership declaration.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: annual related-party transactions exceeding NT$20 million; Master File: multinational group consolidated revenue exceeding NT$30 billion (also the Country-by-Country Reporting threshold).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not maintain a standalone Economic Substance Regulations code equivalent to offshore centres, but Article 12-1 of the Tax Assessment Act codifies the substantive taxation principle. A WFOE lacking real R&D activity, operational staff, a management office, bank accounts, board decision records, or actual business functions in Taiwan may be re-characterized as a shell; its income can be re-attributed to the offshore parent and the Taiwan tax return disregarded for tax purposes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willfully filing a false profit-seeking income tax return by omitting USDC-derived revenue, fabricating vendor invoices for proxy services, or inflating related-party data acquisition costs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty under Income Tax Act Article 110 of not less than 10% and up to 3 times the amount of underpaid tax; criminal liability for tax evasion under Article 41 of the Tax Collection Act carrying imprisonment for up to three years and/or a monetary fine.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or direct the fraudulent return are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and penalties; the National Taxation Bureau may issue travel bans and property freezes; criminal liability extends to the responsible corporate officer with potential imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Taiwan WFOE with no physical office, employees, board records, bank accounts, or genuine business evidence while channeling all profits to a Chinese parent through service fees or dividend distribution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disallowance of intercompany deductions, upward transfer pricing adjustment, re-characterization and reassessment under Article 12-1; penalty of up to 3 times the underpaid tax plus interest for intentional avoidance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners may be assessed as actual taxpayers after piercing the corporate veil; travel restraint orders and restrictions on exiting Taiwan apply to responsible persons with outstanding tax exceeding statutory thresholds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting USDC cryptocurrency payments without registering as a Virtual Asset Service Provider under the Money Laundering Control Act or implementing AML/KYC controls; operating a proxy API gateway used to facilitate laundering of e-commerce proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: De-registration, administrative fines under the Money Laundering Control Act, confiscation of virtual assets, business suspension, or closure by the competent authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Compliance officers and directors face criminal liability for knowingly facilitating money laundering, punishable by imprisonment of up to seven years and fines; travel bans and asset freezes may be imposed during investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring and remitting dividends, royalties, or interest to the Chinese parent without withholding the statutory 20% tax at source, or misclassifying repatriation as loan repayment to avoid dividend withholding tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority collects the un-withheld amount directly from the withholding agent; a surcharge of 1.5 to 2 times the un-withheld amount applies for willful non-withholding, together with penal interest from the original payment date.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorize un-withheld cross-border remittances are personally liable for additional tax and penalties; responsible financial officers may be subject to prosecution and travel bans for unpaid corporate withholding tax.
